note: YAML trees were imported from the official upstream 0.0.14 ESPs. Git does not carry those binaries; this manifest is the lock that only the listed VMAD/StartGameEnabled fields changed, plus three Battle Mage perk descriptions corrected to match the DLL and pinned verbatim.

allowed_record_changes.description: Casting a concentration spell for 4 seconds can trigger Novice or Apprentice spell procs. Requires a Magic Skill of at least 25.
allowed_record_changes.reason: Upstream said 6 seconds; gameloop_hook.cpp has fired at 4.0 since cb89697, and the author kept 4.0 when editing that line in eccfe8b, two days after writing 6 into the README.

allowed_record_changes.description: Spell Procs can trigger Adept and Expert spells. Novice and Apprentice procs cost 75% less magicka instead of 50%. Reduces Cooldown by 20%. Requires 'Alteration' 50.
allowed_record_changes.reason: Adds the quarter-cost Novice and Apprentice procs SpellProc::has_matching_proc grants with this perk; upstream's text omitted them.

allowed_record_changes.description: Spell Procs can trigger Master spells. Adept and Expert procs cost 75% less magicka instead of 50%. Reduces Cooldown by 40% in total. Requires 'Alteration' 75.
allowed_record_changes.reason: Adds the quarter-cost Adept and Expert procs SpellProc::has_matching_proc grants with this perk, and upstream's README note that 40% is the total, not additive.
